requirements.requirement: The system must capture provenance metadata at the moment of each external API call within provider_detail_service.
The system must capture provenance metadata at the moment of each external API call within clinical_trials_service.
The system must populate all required provenance fields (source_type, source_name, api_endpoint, dataset_id, retrieval_timestamp, version) as defined in EVAL-DATA-PROV-S1.
The system must attach provenance metadata to every individual quality measure object before returning from provider_detail_service.
The system must attach provenance metadata to every individual quality measure object before returning from clinical_trials_service.
The system must ensure that retrieval_timestamp reflects the actual time of data fetch in UTC format.
The system must correctly identify and record the source_name corresponding to each external integration (e.g., CMS NPI API, ClinicalTrials.gov, Google Routes).
The system must propagate provenance metadata alongside transformed or normalized measure values without loss or alteration.
The system must ensure that no measure object is returned with missing or null provenance metadata fields under normal operation.
The system must handle external API responses containing partial data by still attaching provenance metadata indicating the originating source.
The system must assign a default or explicit 'unknown' value for dataset_id or version when the external source does not provide them.
The system must not drop provenance metadata during internal data transformations or aggregations.
The system must handle external API failure by not emitting measures without provenance metadata and instead returning an empty or flagged result.
The system must ensure that provenance metadata attachment does not alter the original measure values returned from external sources.
